honesty_boundary: All 2018-2023 history is consumed development research; post-2023 outcomes and CY-011 remain unread and no result is independent confirmation.

track_a.low_volatility_of_volatility: negative 60-session standard deviation of rolling five-session realized volatility
track_a.low_idio: negative 20-session standard deviation of stock causal return minus each date's cross-sectional median causal return
track_a.residual: same-date OLS residual of Low Vol-of-Vol percentile rank on Low-Idio percentile rank
track_a.distinct_gate: absolute median rank correlation below 0.50 and residual top-20 net excess positive full and in both blocks
track_a.industry_gate: within-industry high-minus-low matched payoff spread positive full and in both blocks, with full severe-loss spread nonpositive
track_a.minute_overlap: date-level median Low-Vol-of-Vol percentile rank associated only with ALL_A/NON_ST minute-realized-volatility ordinal progression PIT percentile; descriptive, no conditioning or rule

authorized_translation_only_if_both_gate.baseline: exact Low-Idio top 20 on each 20-session decision date
authorized_translation_only_if_both_gate.rule: choose the 10 highest Low-Vol-of-Vol scores within that frozen Low-Idio top-20 candidate set

track_b.source: Da, Gurun, and Warachka (2014), Frog in the Pan
track_b.mechanism: gradual positive information attracts less attention than isolated jumps and may continue
track_b.score: negative information discreteness sign(sum residual return) times (negative-day fraction minus positive-day fraction), restricted to positive 60-session cumulative residual return

track_b.source: Heston and Sadka (2008), Seasonality in the Cross-Section of Stock Returns
track_b.mechanism: stock-specific return rankings recur in the same calendar month
track_b.score: causal total log return in the same completed calendar month one year earlier

track_b.mechanism: improvement in peer-relative rank may reveal emerging demand before absolute leadership
track_b.score: same-date percentile rank of trailing-20 residual return minus its value 20 sessions earlier

track_b.mechanism: followers whose within-industry rank improves may capture diffusion from established leaders
track_b.score: within-PIT-industry percentile rank of trailing-20 return minus its value 20 sessions earlier, restricted to prior below-industry-median rank

track_b.source: Lou, Polk, and Skouras (2022), Overnight Returns, Daytime Reversals, and Future Stock Returns
track_b.mechanism: repeated positive overnight moves reversed intraday may reflect arbitrageurs overcorrecting informative overnight demand
track_b.score: fraction of prior 20 sessions with positive causal overnight return and negative open-to-close return

track_b.source: Lee and Swaminathan (2000), Price Momentum and Trading Volume
track_b.mechanism: low past turnover may identify neglected/value-like stocks with higher subsequent returns
track_b.score: negative mean registered turnover_fraction over the prior 60 sessions

prohibited: Track-A combined strategy unless both gates pass
